feature_contract.goal: Translate and bind real OutRun D3D9 programmable VS/PS with live resources and input to produce a native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed visible in menu, vehicle selection and race, without altering original DX9Ex fallback

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A real bound game VS/PS pair and its live vertex data, constant registers, textures and render states execute native DX11 Draw/DrawIndexed with visible pixels
Any unsupported shader/register or pipeline state rejects the native candidate while original D3D9 draw, input, FFB and renderer remain authoritative
The integrated programmable source and negative regression tests pass all five mandatory GitHub Actions at one exact validation-bearing SHA

integration_path: intercept real game-authored programmable D3D9 Draw and decode SM3 VS/PS function stream
materialize supported arithmetic/source modifiers as native HLSL/DXBC with fail-closed unsupported instructions
complete live constants/texture/input layout and D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed binding to visible native full game frame
batch_components: native_backend.cpp SM3 opcode decoding into translated artifact source
native_sm3_arithmetic_codegen.hpp source modifier and arithmetic HLSL emitter
development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: NOT_ACHIEVED: source subset expansion built and verified only; real-game playable native DX11 frame is still pending
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Diagnostic-only SM3 subset translation; runtime native programmable object binding remains disabled until live constants, shader resources, vertex declaration, and Draw target parity are actually implemented and verified; original D3D9 Draw, gamepad/FFB, DX9Ex fallback preserved; DXVK frozen

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: SM3 RCP/RSQ/EXP/LOG/POW/LRP/NRM/CRS/DP2ADD and source-modifier HLSL regression compiled under -Werror in DX11 Fast Gate
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Undefined NRM/CRS W writes, unknown modifiers and unsupported bytecode paths fail closed without bypassing renderer safety controls
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 SM3 bytecode decoder opcode translation now feeds existing R283 DXBC materializer; live native pipeline/real-game Draw binding is still missing
